blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified 2026-10-19 on Solana mainnet at slot 458729686: the Token-program mint J9BcrQfX4p9D1bvLzRNCbMDv8f44a9LFdeqNE4Yk2WMD (6 decimals, supply 1,116,455.895338 ISC) has non-null freeze authority 3XM6WqYLx5gKpRNwnCcUrBmJAhRHx3imktwEvbRwXavZ, which is also its mint authority. At slot 458730572 that address is an initialized SPL Token multisig with numRequiredSigners=2 and numValidSigners=3 (signers B6PG7xN8W1G3PA8XoTzUEAdzNzWfDXQeWud5axWtHCPi, FUPe37ryYxB2J8Ckvq3pzpw7EMahYyeT8WtzJqh3Ge3f, 3kHz9pTwSeCz6JemWsKoKMPS8E1RUbwbU2xg1b1ajFGF). Solana freezes individual token accounts through the mint's freeze authority, so the 2-of-3 issuer multisig can freeze any holder's account: direct holder-account freeze. ISC is a single Solana deployment holding 100% of supply. No parent: variantOf and mintAuthority.inheritedFrom are null. Reserve composition (RWA fund shares and cash) is not the basis of this verdict.

oracleRisk.summary: ISC has no on-chain price feed and no borrower market. The issuer computes the ISC Target Price off-chain as the summed value of the Reserve Basket (p_isc = sum of p_asset x q_asset), the daily rebalance trades that basket at the next day's VWAP, and the ISC Issuer sizes and recalls ISC loans to the Reserves using the liquidity and price of ISC. At Solana mainnet slot 462996906 (2026-10-29T19:21:38Z) the ISC mint is a plain SPL Token-program mint whose mint authority and freeze authority are the 2-of-3 multisig 3XM6WqYLx5gKpRNwnCcUrBmJAhRHx3imktwEvbRwXavZ, so no program can gate issuance on an external price. This review classifies the documented top-level pricing authority only; it does not verify individual execution prices or the discretion applied to loan sizing.

branchApplicability.rationale: The only price-sensitive control in the live stabilization path is the top-level issuance/redemption quote struck against the issuer's Target Price. The reviewed mechanism has no borrower collateral, liquidation or backstop branches (no CDP, lending market or liquidation engine consumes an ISC price), so declaring a borrower-branch set would invent one.
